small_profile.limitations: Sequential mode blocks during another fit; fresh plugin in both modes; cProfile does not isolate all native DSP. Correctness evidence only; no reuse speedup or DSP-only speed claim.

normalization_decision: Defer unnormalized versus LUFS versus peak input preprocessing to a later controlled comparison; no current normalization winner or loss change.
